title: Avro Lancaster PB565
memorial_details: Stone of remembrance with an engraved plaque set into it. The plaque has the badges of the RAF & RAAF at top with the dedication and crew members names below. There is an information board on a wooden frame to the left with beneath, a stone tablet with the engraving of the Lancaster on it, and a wooden board with a Lancaster painting, crew list and epitaph on it. The whole is set within wooden fencing and set on stone slabs, either side of the entrance are two substantial wooden benches.
inscription: RAF Badge/ RAAF Badge/ IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF/ AVRO LANCASTER PB565 OF 1667 HCU, RAF SANDTOFT/ WHICH CRASHED 150 METRES BEYOND THIS STONE/ 15th APRIL 1945/ (names)/ WHEN YOU GO HOME, TELL THEM OF US AND SAY/ FOR YOUR TOMORROW, WE GAVE OUR TODAY
community_connection: RAF SANDTOFT, IN MEMORY OF THE CREW
